import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import pytest

# Import the public API that is available in the codebase
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.tree import Tree
from doorstop import common


# Helper to create a temporary project directory
@pytest.fixture
def tmp_project(tmp_path):
    """Return a path to a fresh temporary project directory."""
    return tmp_path


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_001
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_001(tmp_project):
    """
    Store requirements permanently and securely
    """
    # Create a new document in the temporary project
    doc_path = os.path.join(tmp_project, "doc1.md")
    doc = Document.new(doc_path, title="Test Document")

    # Add a requirement item
    item = doc.add_item("Requirement 1")

    # Persist the document to disk
    doc.save()

    # Reload the document from disk
    reloaded_doc = Document.load(doc_path)

    # Verify that the requirement is present after reload
    reloaded_item = reloaded_doc.find_item(item.uid)
    assert reloaded_item is not None, "Requirement was not persisted"
    assert reloaded_item.text == "Requirement 1", "Requirement text mismatch"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_002
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_002(tmp_project):
    """
    Handle change management
    """
    # Create a document and add an initial requirement
    doc_path = os.path.join(tmp_project, "doc2.md")
    doc = Document.new(doc_path, title="Change Test")
    item = doc.add_item("Requirement 1")
    doc.save()

    # Update the requirement text
    item.text = "Updated Requirement 1"
    doc.save()

    # Reload and verify the updated text
    reloaded_doc = Document.load(doc_path)
    reloaded_item = reloaded_doc.find_item(item.uid)
    assert reloaded_item.text == "Updated Requirement 1", "Requirement was not updated"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_003
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_003(tmp_project):
    """
    Associate requirements changes to developer
    """
    # The current implementation does not expose a developer association API.
    # Therefore this test is not automatable with the public API.
    pytest.skip("NOT_AUTOMATABLE: No public API to associate a developer with a requirement.")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_004
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_004(tmp_project):
    """
    Scale to support thousands of requirements
    """
    # Create a document and add 1000 requirements
    doc_path = os.path.join(tmp_project, "doc3.md")
    doc = Document.new(doc_path, title="Large Scale Test")
    for i in range(1, 1001):
        doc.add_item(f"Requirement {i}")
    doc.save()

    # Reload and count the items
    reloaded_doc = Document.load(doc_path)
    items = reloaded_doc.items
    assert len(items) == 1000, f"Expected 1000 requirements, found {len(items)}"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_005
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_005():
    """
    Provide lightweight installation method
    """
    # The presence of the doorstop package itself indicates a lightweight install.
    # We simply import the package and check that the main entry point exists.
    try:
        import doorstop
    except ImportError:
        pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: doorstop package not installed in test environment.")
    assert hasattr(doorstop, "cli"), "doorstop.cli module missing"
    assert hasattr(doorstop, "core"), "doorstop.core module missing"
